dct_description_sm: Aerial view of the borough of Wyoming, the Wyoming Valley, and a section of the Susquehanna River northward to horizon.

Aerial view of the borough of Wyoming, the Wyoming Valley, and a section of the Susquehanna River northward to horizon. Relief shown by shading and landform drawings. Printed in black and pale gray (outer border and title lettering). LC copy imperfect: Stained (from previous framing) in margins, stain partially obliterates part of statement of attribution, mounted on cloth backing. Includes captions in lower border: Wyoming Monument -- Queen Esthers Rock -- Pittston. Library of Congress. Panoramic maps of cities in the United States and Canada (2nd ed.), 876.1 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
